lines.text: Do you know how Morse code works? Every letter is just short and long beeps.
Press a key, and you close an electric circuit. Miles away, a sounder clicks. Short is a dot, long is a dash.
The most common letters got the shortest codes. E is a single dot. T is a single dash.
In eighteen forty four, Samuel Morse sent the words, What hath God wrought, from Washington to Baltimore.
S O S is three dots, three dashes, three dots. It isn't short for anything. It's just impossible to miss.
Orbi gives every file a code too, a QR code. Scan it to land right on the file, and add a code, so only people who know it can open it.
